body:
The Truth Shall Make You Free · 2012-12-23 · Elder Nathanyel, with Deacon Asaph

Opens [John 8](/bible/john/8) · [Deut 28](/bible/deuteronomy/28) · [Exod 4](/bible/exodus/4) · [John 5](/bible/john/5) · [Lev 11](/bible/leviticus/11) · [John 9](/bible/john/9) · [Matt 9](/bible/matthew/9) · [Sir 30](/bible/sirach/30) · [Baruch 3](/bible/baruch/3) · [Sir 38](/bible/sirach/38) · [Ps 103](/bible/psalms/103) · [Heb 13](/bible/hebrews/13) · [2 Chr 16](/bible/2-chronicles/16) · [Job 13](/bible/job/13) · [Sir 31](/bible/sirach/31) · [2 Kgs 13](/bible/2-kings/13) · and 3 more below
## Introduction *[[0:22](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=47FuyanZ7e8&t=22s)]* Today's topic is sickness and health. Where does it come from? What is the root of sickness, what is the root of health, where does it come from, how do we attain it? It is the one true God, the Lord of heaven and earth, that brings sickness and disease upon rebellious Israelites, and nine times out of ten the root of the sickness is sin, is breaking God's commandments. ## Scriptures Opened **[John 8:32](/bible/john/8#v32)** *[[0:22](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=47FuyanZ7e8&t=22s)]* > [32](/bible/john/8#v32) And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free. - Black man, black woman, Latin man and Latin woman, if you want to be set free, if you want salvation, liberation, you must humble yourself as the Israelites and repent of your sins. - Sickness and health: where does it come from? What is the root of sickness, what is the root of health, where does it come from, how do we attain it? **[Deuteronomy 28:15,61](/bible/deuteronomy/28#v15)** *[[0:22](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=47FuyanZ7e8&t=22s)]* > [15](/bible/deuteronomy/28#v15) But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day; that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee: > > [61](/bible/deuteronomy/28#v61) Also every sickness, and every plague, which is not written in the book of this law, them will the Lord bring upon thee, until thou be destroyed. - Moses was telling the Israelites: if you break the Most High's laws, all these curses that I'm about to explain are going to come upon you and overtake you. - Every sickness and every plague which is not written in the book of this law, the Bible. Like what? Is AIDS written in here? No, not as AIDS. Cancer, no. Herpes, no. Gonorrhea, no. There's many sicknesses and many plagues: diabetes, not written in here. - A lot of you never learned this. You never understood that it is the one true God, the Lord of heaven and earth, that brings sickness and disease upon rebellious Israelites. - Our people, we're the Israelites, and we are a very rebellious people, and the Most High prophesied: if you break my commandments, every sickness and every plague will I bring upon you. **[Exodus 4:11](/bible/exodus/4#v11)** *[[2:50](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=47FuyanZ7e8&t=170s)]* > [11](/bible/exodus/4#v11) And the Lord said unto him, Who hath made man’s mouth? or who maketh the dumb, or deaf, or the seeing, or the blind? have not I the Lord? - You get some that write us and call us, many of you ask questions on the street: my son, my daughter, my mom may be deaf or may not be able to speak. Where does that come from? - What does that mean? It means he made the people dumb, can't speak; he made them blind, can't see; or deaf, cannot hear. It's the Lord of heaven and earth. **[John 5:1-8,13-14](/bible/john/5#v1)** *[[3:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=47FuyanZ7e8&t=225s)]* > [1](/bible/john/5#v1) After this there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem. > > [2](/bible/john/5#v2) Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches. > > [3](/bible/john/5#v3) In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water. > > [4](/bible/john/5#v4) For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool, and troubled the water: whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had. > > [5](/bible/john/5#v5) And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years. > > [6](/bible/john/5#v6) When Jesus saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case, he saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole? > > [7](/bible/john/5#v7) The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me. > > [8](/bible/john/5#v8) Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy bed, and walk. > > [13](/bible/john/5#v13) And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in that place. > > [14](/bible/john/5#v14) Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee. - There was a pool called Bethesda, and many Israelites laid around this pool; some of them were very impotent. - There was a custom: there was a pool of water, the Most High would send an angel to trouble the water, and whoever of all those Israelites got in first was healed of all diseases they may have had. - Thirty-eight years he had this plague, he had this sickness, he had this disease. Christ asked this man: will you be made whole? Do you want to be healed of your sickness, of your disease? - He said: I got nobody to put me in the water. Every time the water is troubled by the angel, the second I'm about to get in, somebody goes 'move' and jumps in the water and gets healed first. So this man had nobody to help him get healed. - He didn't know who had healed him; Christ had taken himself away. Afterward Christ found him in the temple: behold, thou art made whole, I have healed you. Sin no more: don't break the law no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee. - So why did this man have disease for 38 years? Sin, breaking God's commandments, like a lot of you at home. Precepts: - **[1 John 3:4](/bible/1-john/3#v4)** > [4](/bible/1-john/3#v4) Whosoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law. A lot of you are saying, what does sin mean? Sin is the transgression of the law. **[Leviticus 11:7](/bible/leviticus/11#v7)** *[[7:38](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=47FuyanZ7e8&t=458s)]* > [7](/bible/leviticus/11#v7) And the swine, though he divide the hoof, and be clovenfooted, yet he cheweth not the cud; he is unclean to you. - What is the swine talking about? Pigs, hogs. The swine divides the hoof, meaning he has a cloven hoof that has a split in it; he's clovenfooted because it's a hard hoof. - He does not chew the cud, meaning he doesn't chew up grass, swallow it into one stomach, regurgitate it, chew it again, swallow it into another stomach. That's what chew the cud means. - Of their flesh you shall not eat. But look and examine the Negro and Latino today: pork, what they call it, the new white meat; they got commercials. Growing up in the South you got hog maws, you got chitlins, you got pig ears, pig feet, pig tail; you eat everything on a pig. - As you get older, a lot of women get gout in their ankles: the ankles start to swell and the legs getting bigger around the ankle, so your ankles become cankles. Doctor, why do my legs like this? Well Mary, you have gout, a disease that comes from the eating of swine. Stop eating the swine. Then you come home: I shouldn't eat pork no more. Why not, Mama? Because the white man said I shouldn't eat pork no more. You simple black woman. - I'm getting on you because a lot of you, you men too, you and your Baptist churches and all that foolishness, you eat the pig, you raise the kids up on that stuff. I was there, been there, done that, but I thank the Lord what he delivered me from that. **[John 9:1-3](/bible/john/9#v1)** *[[10:03](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=47FuyanZ7e8&t=603s)]* > [1](/bible/john/9#v1) And as Jesus passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth. > > [2](/bible/john/9#v2) And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind? > > [3](/bible/john/9#v3) Jesus answered, Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest in him. - What Christ said to that man, sin no more lest a worse thing come upon you, is what Moses told us as a people: if you break God's commandments, every sickness and every plague which is not written in this book of the law shall the Lord bring upon thee. - That shows you that all these preachers that got these fake faith healings is fake, fake, fake. Christ healed the man and said sin no more: you like this because you've been breaking the commandments, that's why you jacked up. These preachers, let me lay hands on you, they never come with that. By my prayer cloth, with their sweat: you healed in the name of Jesus. Then she go right back to doing whatever the hell she was doing before. - This man was blind from his birth. Who caused the blind? Didn't we read in Exodus 4:11 earlier: the Most High said he makes the deaf, he makes the blind, he makes the dumb. - If he was born blind, why did they ask did that man sin, that he was born like that? They understood something that you at home don't understand, because it is appointed unto men once to die and after that the judgment, like it says in the book of Hebrews. You die today, your spirit goes up before the Lord, and the Lord says you've been very wicked in the earth, I'm going to send you back: this time you may be born blind, you may be born deaf. The Most High has his own reasons. But that's for another topic. - A lot of times you as parents don't realize that many of the things that you do result in how that child is born, because of the sins that you commit. A lot of the things that come upon your children now and again is a result of what the parents have done in their lives. You've never been taught this Bible; you've lived your life a fairy tale. - Christ said this man did not sin, and it wasn't his parents; this man was born blind so that I could work the works of God. Christ and all the Israelites understood regeneration, that you come back in the world again and again. That's why when come Judgment Day there's going to be no mistakes: that baby that died this time at the age of three months, it's been here many times. **[John 9:19-34](/bible/john/9#v19)** *[[14:44](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=47FuyanZ7e8&t=884s)]* > [19](/bible/john/9#v19) And they asked them, saying, Is this your son, who ye say was born blind? how then doth he now see? > > [20](/bible/john/9#v20) His parents answered them and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind: > > [21](/bible/john/9#v21) But by what means he now seeth, we know not; or who hath opened his eyes, we know not: he is of age; ask him: he shall speak for himself. > > [22](/bible/john/9#v22) These words spake his parents, because they feared the Jews: for the Jews had agreed already, that if any man did confess that he was Christ, he should be put out of the synagogue. > > [23](/bible/john/9#v23) Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him. > > [24](/bible/john/9#v24) Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give God the praise: we know that this man is a sinner. > > [25](/bible/john/9#v25) He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see. > > [26](/bible/john/9#v26) Then said they to him again, What did he to thee? how opened he thine eyes? > > [27](/bible/john/9#v27) He answered them, I have told you already, and ye did not hear: wherefore would ye hear it again? will ye also be his disciples? > > [28](/bible/john/9#v28) Then they reviled him, and said, Thou art his disciple; but we are Moses’ disciples. > > [29](/bible/john/9#v29) We know that God spake unto Moses: as for this fellow, we know not from whence he is. > > [30](/bible/john/9#v30) The man answered and said unto them, Why herein is a marvellous thing, that ye know not from whence he is, and yet he hath opened mine eyes. > > [31](/bible/john/9#v31) Now we know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, and doeth his will, him he heareth. > > [32](/bible/john/9#v32) Since the world began was it not heard that any man opened the eyes of one that was born blind. > > [33](/bible/john/9#v33) If this man were not of God, he could do nothing. > > [34](/bible/john/9#v34) They answered and said unto him, Thou wast altogether born in sins, and dost thou teach us? And they cast him out. - Once the young man was healed, the Pharisees said, call the man's parents. His parents said: we know this is our boy, he was born blind, but we don't know how he's able to see. He's a grown man, why don't you ask our son? - They said ask our boy because they feared that the Jews would cast them out of the synagogue. A lot of you right now hear this truth, you've been watching for some time now and you believe, but you will never confront your preacher, you will never utter it in your little church congregation, because you think if I confess this truth, that we as a people are the Israelites, Christ only died for our people, we got to keep these laws, your preacher's going to cast you out the church. So you stay quiet, but you still go. - You don't want to confess it to your parents either, because your mama or daddy might go tell the preacher. Some of the men know they can't bring it home to their wives. The Most High cannot deal with a fearful. Christ said whoever is ashamed of me, I will be ashamed of you before my father and the angels. - You follow that Jesus guy, but we Moses' disciples. Like some of these Israelites that don't believe in Christ: you write letters to us and say we know that God spoke to Moses, but this guy Jesus, some of you called JC, we don't know where he's from. - He has sarcasm against the scribes: this is a marvelous thing, you leaders, you scribes and Pharisees, the masters of Israel, this man has opened the eyes of the blind and you don't know who he is. God don't hear sinners, but any man that is a worshipper of God and does the commandments, him the Lord hears. - Check from the book of Genesis all the way up: who in the scriptures was born blind and received their sight again? If this man Christ was not of God he could have done nothing. They said, you was born in sin, you going to teach us? We the masters of Israel. And they threw the brother out the church. When you read on, Christ went to the man and told him come follow me. - That's how you brothers and sisters got to be resilient. Your wicked church membership, you might have 10,000 members: to hell with them if they can't repent. Leave them be and come serve the one true God. **[Matthew 9:1-7](/bible/matthew/9#v1)** *[[21:18](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=47FuyanZ7e8&t=1278s)]* > [1](/bible/matthew/9#v1) And he entered into a ship, and passed over, and came into his own city. > > [2](/bible/matthew/9#v2) And, behold, they brought to him a man sick of the palsy, lying on a bed: and Jesus seeing their faith said unto the sick of the palsy; Son, be of good cheer; thy sins be forgiven thee. > > [3](/bible/matthew/9#v3) And, behold, certain of the scribes said within themselves, This man blasphemeth. > > [4](/bible/matthew/9#v4) And Jesus knowing their thoughts said, Wherefore think ye evil in your hearts? > > [5](/bible/matthew/9#v5) For whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and walk? > > [6](/bible/matthew/9#v6) But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (then saith he to the sick of the palsy,) Arise, take up thy bed, and go unto thine house. > > [7](/bible/matthew/9#v7) And he arose, and departed to his house. - This man had cerebral palsy, laying on a bed. A lot of you see these Jerry Lewis telethons for kids, and all these kids got cerebral palsy. - Why did this man have cerebral palsy? Because of sin, because of breaking God's commandments. Before you write us letters: the Bible declares sin is the result of these sicknesses, of these diseases. Sins they have done before, sins that may have been caused by the parent even. - They said this man Christ is a blasphemer. Christ said, why do you think evil in your mind? That shows you Christ could read spirits. He's looking at me like I'm the devil; I'm telling a man his sins is forgiven, he giving me that look. - What's easier to say? If you say your sins be forgiven you, that means you are God on earth; if you say rise up and walk, you still saying you got that power. You can't tell a dude with cerebral palsy stand up and walk; everybody look at you like you're crazy. Both them things is hard. - Christ could say both things. Why? Because he had the power. He's the master, he's the King of kings, the Lord of lords. **[Sirach 30:14-17](/bible/sirach/30#v14)** *[[24:25](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=47FuyanZ7e8&t=1465s)]* > [14](/bible/sirach/30#v14) Better is the poor, being sound and strong of constitution, than a rich man that is afflicted in his body. > > [15](/bible/sirach/30#v15) Health and good estate of body are above all gold, and a strong body above infinite wealth. > > [16](/bible/sirach/30#v16) There is no riches above a sound body, and no joy above the joy of the heart. > > [17](/bible/sirach/30#v17) Death is better than a bitter life or continual sickness. - You need to get your Apocrypha. Like I always explain on many episodes, the Apocrypha was taken out of the original King James 1611 Bible. It used to be in there, but in the 1700s the Protestant Christian whites took it out of the Bible. - A lot of you struggle about your finances, you all upset about not having enough. Guess what, you never going to have enough. - Better is the poor, being sound mind and of good health in his body, than a rich man that is afflicted in his body. You got some rich people, body all jacked up. No, I'd rather stay poor. - When you look at the pictures of all our ancestors in hard bondage slavery, they was poor, they had rags on, they had slop to eat, but they were sound mind, they were healthy. You had master in the house, rich, sick as hell on a bed: bring one of those slave babies and let me put my feet on them to draw the rheumatism out the body. - Death is better than a life of continual sickness. I had a cousin who was born with diabetes. She was in the hospital every two months from youth all the way up; she said I can't have children, I can't even get married, every time I meet a man I come back in the hospital. She died; I think she was about 28. So I understand the scripture; I've seen it. - Another relative had cancer in the breast. She said no, I'm not doing chemo no more. She was rebellious as hell; I used to try to show the scriptures, she used to party all the time. You got to repent, get your life right. Nah, you do that Bible thing, I'm getting my groove on. The cancer just took her over; the breast got like a rock; she was sick day upon day. **[Baruch 3:8](/bible/baruch/3#v8)** *[[25:12](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=47FuyanZ7e8&t=1512s)]* > [8](/bible/baruch/3#v8) Behold, we are yet this day in our captivity, where thou hast scattered us, for a reproach and a curse, and to be subject to payments, according to all the iniquities of our fathers, which departed from the Lord our God. - For always complaining and struggling about bill after bill: they got a thing on CNN that Soledad O'Brien did about the new slavery for the black man, called debt. - A lot of you black men and black women have forgotten that you are yet this day in your captivity. Your ancestors was brought to this country to serve slavery; just because the yoke of iron is off your neck, you unlearned Negroes think you free. - Nobody love you, Mr. black man: you are scattered here for a reproach and a curse. That's why whenever you move around white people, they say real estate go down; that's why when you want to buy a house the interest rate go up, the loan is more greater. - So what you talking about, you always got bills? The Bible says we are subject to payments. You ain't free, Negro. I don't care how rich you be, you ain't free. **[Sirach 38:1-4](/bible/sirach/38#v1)** *[[30:39](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=47FuyanZ7e8&t=1839s)]* > [1](/bible/sirach/38#v1) Honour a physician with the honour due unto him for the uses which ye may have of him: for the Lord hath created him. > > [2](/bible/sirach/38#v2) For of the most High cometh healing, and he shall receive honour of the king. > > [3](/bible/sirach/38#v3) The skill of the physician shall lift up his head: and in the sight of great men he shall be in admiration. > > [4](/bible/sirach/38#v4) The Lord hath created medicines out of the earth; and he that is wise will not abhor them. - Some of you sit at home and go, oh it's easy for them to say, they ain't been through nothing. Oh no, we've been through a lot. I can tell you many life experiences, and that helps us become better teachers, better instructors, because we've been there. - This was talking about the Israelite physicians, but I have to bring it up to today, because there's some of us who refuse to go to the doctor: oh no, I'm just going to drink some bitter herb and tea, smoke weed, we going to heal. You crazy. - Regardless of the physician, you got your doctor, the Bible declares it's the Most High that really does the healing. - The Lord has created medicines out of the earth, like many of the herbs that grow; that's where the healing begins. The Most High is the one that does it ultimately, but he gives herbs to help man. He that is wise will not hate them. **[Sirach 38:9-12](/bible/sirach/38#v9)** *[[32:51](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=47FuyanZ7e8&t=1971s)]* > [9](/bible/sirach/38#v9) My son, in thy sickness be not negligent: but pray unto the Lord, and he will make thee whole. > > [10](/bible/sirach/38#v10) Leave off from sin, and order thine hands aright, and cleanse thy heart from all wickedness. > > [11](/bible/sirach/38#v11) Give a sweet savour, and a memorial of fine flour; and make a fat offering, as not being. > > [12](/bible/sirach/38#v12) Then give place to the physician, for the Lord hath created him: let him not go from thee, for thou hast need of him. - My son, in your sickness don't be negligent, but pray unto the Lord, and he will make thee whole: the Most High will bring forth the healing. - One of the main things we as a people need to start doing: humble ourselves and pray. Leave off from sin. Why does it say leave off from sin? Because nine times out of ten the root of the sickness is sin, is breaking God's commandments. - Order your hands aright, do what the Bible says, and cleanse your mind from all wickedness. - A sweet savour and a memorial of fine flour, meaning a sacrifice. We no longer give this memorial of a sacrifice of fine flour, because Christ took the place of the sacrifice. So now we as a people must pray to the heavenly father in the name of Christ. - Once you've prayed to the Lord, you've sacrificed the words of your lips in the name of Christ, then give place to the physician. Don't let him go from thee: you got need of a doctor. **[Psalms 103:2-3,18](/bible/psalms/103#v2)** *[[32:51](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=47FuyanZ7e8&t=1971s)]* > [2](/bible/psalms/103#v2) Bless the Lord, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits: > > [3](/bible/psalms/103#v3) Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases; > > [18](/bible/psalms/103#v18) To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them. - I just want to jump back and forth for a moment, precept upon precept, line upon line. Forget not all his benefits, his blessings. - Who forgiveth all iniquity, who healeth all diseases: them two things go together, because the root of the sicknesses and disease is sin. There is certain other ways you can get it, but I'm going to deal with that as we get to it. - The Most High brings forth healing to those that remember his covenant. **[Hebrews 13:4](/bible/hebrews/13#v4)** *[[35:12](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=47FuyanZ7e8&t=2112s)]* > [4](/bible/hebrews/13#v4) Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge. - Ask the brother, ask the sister who has herpes simplex: where'd it come from? - You got some brothers, some sisters: oh no, I don't want to get married, I want to live my life as a whoremonger, booty call here, booty call there. And adultery: that brother, sister married, creeping out at night. God will judge. - How do you think one of the ways God judges you? It's called herpes, it's called AIDS, it's called gonorrhea, it's called crabs. Brother, why you scratching? **[2 Chronicles 16:12-13](/bible/2-chronicles/16#v12)** *[[36:46](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=47FuyanZ7e8&t=2206s)]* > [12](/bible/2-chronicles/16#v12) And Asa in the thirty and ninth year of his reign was diseased in his feet, until his disease was exceeding great: yet in his disease he sought not to the Lord, but to the physicians. > > [13](/bible/2-chronicles/16#v13) And Asa slept with his fathers, and died in the one and fortieth year of his reign. - I'm going to show you something dealing with a physician, which is a doctor: something that King Asa did regarding the Most High and the doctor. See if you pick up on it. - He had a disease in his feet, so great in his feet; yet in his disease he sought not the Lord. He didn't go to the Lord in prayer, he didn't go to the Lord in humility, but he rather dealt with the doctor; he went straight to the physician. - Asa slept with his fathers, meaning he dropped dead, because healing, believe it or not, ultimately is the decision of the Most High God. It comes from him. - King Asa didn't seek to the Lord, he went to his doctor: doctor, heal me. Doctor said lay down on my table and see what I do for you; oh, can't do nothing for you. Asa drop dead. So let us not make that mistake. **[Sirach 38:13-15](/bible/sirach/38#v13)** *[[37:35](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=47FuyanZ7e8&t=2255s)]* > [13](/bible/sirach/38#v13) There is a time when in their hands there is good success. > > [14](/bible/sirach/38#v14) For they shall also pray unto the Lord, that he would prosper that, which they give for ease and remedy to prolong life. > > [15](/bible/sirach/38#v15) He that sinneth before his Maker, let him fall into the hand of the physician. - The physician back in the ancient days used to pray unto the Lord that he would prosper that which they give for ease and remedy, to prolong life. - He that sinneth before his maker, he that breaks the commandments, let him fall into the hand of the physician: you better go to the doctor, because you are about to get jacked up in the body. You're about to get sick, you're about to catch a disease. **[Job 13:4](/bible/job/13#v4)** *[[38:19](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=47FuyanZ7e8&t=2299s)]* > [4](/bible/job/13#v4) But ye are forgers of lies, ye are all physicians of no value. - I'm going to show you what the Bible says about the white man's physicians today.
